epitope_set.note: t_cell entries are the per-candidate selected epitopes (S6 input and S10 ELISpot peptide pools)

limits: pLDDT and validator agreement describe the quality of the structural MODEL, not the antigen's immunogenicity or protective potential
the same sequence can score differently under different refolders (MotifBench: 28.05 with ESMFold vs 22.5 with AF2-no-MSA) - always read the validator spread

no docking score, TLR docking or affinity is produced: ClusPro blind docking is 13.7% top-1 / 45.1% top-10 and a docking score is neither affinity nor immunogenicity; Boltz-2's affinity head supports protein-small-molecule binding only
final_score weights are unvalidated priors intended to be re-tuned by the retrospective validation harness
structure-informed ranking exists only for the top-k; the remaining candidates keep their pre-structure order below them

selection.basis: pre-structure composite of S3, S5 T-cell, S5 B-cell, S6 coverage terms (percentile-ranked)

ties.basis: top-k: equal final score and pre-structure score; rest: equal pre-structure score and S3 position. `rank` is the ordinal position; inside a tie the order is by protein_id only, not by evidence

s3_leakage_audit.model: Vaxign-ML (stock pretrained model, trained on all of Protegen)
s3_leakage_audit.note: Scores supplied externally; whether the model held out the target pathogen is declared, not verified here.

s3_ranker.note: Default weights reproduce the pure Vaxign-ML ordering; other terms are recorded as evidence only.
s3_ranker.score_semantics: protegenicity in [0,1] = Vaxign-ML percentile/100 (see tool record)
